name: Homepage_KGS_Rastede
description: Die Homepage der KGS Rastede, programmiert mit dem CMS Kirby

scripts.build: npm run build:dev && npm run build:prod
scripts.pull-blog: lftp -u p8102927-kirby sftp://home33042222.1and1-data.host -e "mirror --verbose content/0_blogs content/0_blogs; quit"
scripts.pull-presse: lftp -u p8102927-kirby sftp://home33042222.1and1-data.host -e "set xfer:clobber on; get content/schule/presse/presse.txt -o content/schule/presse/presse.txt; quit"
scripts.pull-faecher: lftp -u p8102927-kirby sftp://home33042222.1and1-data.host -e "mirror --verbose content/2_Faecher content/2_Faecher; quit"
scripts.pull-sprechtag: lftp -u p8102927-kirby sftp://home33042222.1and1-data.host -e "mirror --verbose -X '*.html' content/sprechtag content/sprechtag; mirror --verbose site/blueprints site/blueprints; mirror --verbose site/templates site/templates; mirror --verbose site/controllers site/controllers; mirror --verbose site/models site/models; mirror --verbose site/snippets site/snippets; mirror --verbose -X secrets.php -X .license site/config site/config; quit"
scripts.pull-unterricht: lftp -u p8102927-kirby sftp://home33042222.1and1-data.host -e "mirror --verbose content/unterricht content/unterricht; quit"
scripts.pull-kontakte: lftp -u p8102927-kirby sftp://home33042222.1and1-data.host -e "mirror --verbose content/1_kontakte content/1_kontakte; quit"
